title: CNDY and JUCE Join Forces!
story: CNDY and JUCE have decided to work together. This means they'll help each other make even better candy and juice.
storyBig: CNDY has acquired JUCE in a strategic move to expand its footprint in the beverage sector. This acquisition aims to enhance product offerings and capture a larger market share in the nutritional industry.

rss: I quit my £80,000 job to make ice cream - here's how
title: ICEE Founder Follows A Dream
story: The person who started ICEE left a different job to make tasty ice cream. They wanted to make something special and fun.
storyBig: The ICEE co-founder transitioned from a high-paying job to pursue a passion for creating unique ice cream flavors. This entrepreneurial journey highlights the importance of following one's dreams and innovation in business.
